description: Cogitate (2025): face orientation (left, right, front) was decoded in posterior but not prefrontal regions in iEEG and fMRI, with Bayes factors favoring no prefrontal decoding. MEG showed weak prefrontal decoding with possible leakage from posterior sources.
limitations: One adversarial study of visual consciousness with suprathreshold faces, objects, letters and false fonts. Tests only the predictions both teams preregistered.

sources.quote: decoding of face orientation (left, right or front views) was achieved in posterior but not in prefrontal ROIs
